description_en: Deletes an AI outbound call task based on the instance ID and task ID. After the task is deleted, it cannot be retrieved when you query the list of outbound call tasks
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID删除智能外呼任务。删除后，获取外呼任务列表时无法获取到该任务
name: DeleteAiOutboundTask

parameters.help_en: The AICCS instance ID. You can obtain the instance ID in the Instances section of the left-side navigation pane in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html operation and view the Data parameter in the response, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html operation and view the TaskId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html接口，查看返回参数中的**Data**，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html接口，查看返回参数中的**TaskId**
parameters.name: task_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
